title: PO Agent Grounded Chunk Contract (GroundedChunk v1)
description: Frozen Sprint 28 interface contract (WS-G0, issue #377). Every PO Agent class tool (A corpus / B live-proof / C cost / D ontology) returns GroundedChunk[]; the citation layer renders all four classes identically. Advisory-only, source-grounded, no PHI. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-25-sprint-28-po-agent-contracts.md and docs/adr/0043-product-owner-agent-foundry-iq-domain.md.

classId.description: Knowledge class that produced the chunk: A corpus, B live-proof, C cost, D ontology.

sourceRef.description: Mandatory provenance handle: Class A = doc path + commit; Class B = feed + as-of; Class C = cost feed + BVA baseline + as-of; Class D = data-agent artefact ref.

anchor.description: Optional in-source anchor (heading, line, ADR id, cell).

conceptRef.description: Class D only: ontology concept the answer is grounded on (required for Class D).

goldBinding.description: Class D only: gold-layer binding backing the concept (required for Class D).

asOf.description: ISO-8601 freshness stamp for the chunk.

liveness.description: live = resolved from a live source at answer time; snapshot = degraded to a stored value (Class B/C/D on probe failure).

status.description: Grounding status the answer card surfaces as a chip.

language.description: Source language of the chunk (DE/EN parity with transparency).
